LESSON: WEAVING CRAFT

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PAPER
Topic 5.1: Weaving CRAFT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Weaving CRAFT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify materials for weaving for familiarization
2. Weave using papers for fun.
3. Appreciate own and others work groups as they practice weaving. they work in groups. and gallery walk.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify materials for weaving for familiarization
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify materials for weaving for familiarization. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Weave using papers for fun.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to weave using papers for fun. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate own and others work groups as they practice weaving. they work in groups. and gallery walk.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate own and others work groups as they practice weaving. they work in groups. and gallery walk. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Weaving CRAFT.
2. Explain Weaving CRAFT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

4. Show that you can: Identify materials for weaving for familiarization
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Weaving CRAFT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Weaving CRAFT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
